model.description: The {@link ModelInference} route to use for inference.

auth.description:
This field is unused for {@link GenaiCore.Llm.Mis.Model}, which leverages an internal
C3 service and does not need separate auth specification.

processor.description:
Pre- and post-processing functions to use on the input and output
of the LLM service, respectively.

defaultOptions.description:
Default values to provide for the task. Caller-provided option values (e.g. `completion#options`)
will be merged and take precedence.

useLegacyMisApi.description:
If set, then the legacy single-completion API {@link ModelInference#completion} will be used.
If not, then the {@link ModelInference} chat completion API will be used.

inferenceSupportsVision.description: Set this to `true` if {@link #model} supports image inputs for chat completion.

title:
This type represents a model served through C3's {@link ModelInference} service.
While {@link #completion} could be called directly, it is recommended to instead use
{@link GenaiCore.Llm.Completion.Client}.
name: GenaiCore.Llm.Mis.Model
